text:
Marta: Quick design check — I'm pushing a small iteration for the private setup stepper (figma: /files/stepper-illustrated). Main questions: do the illustrated micro-guides help non-dev admins? Also need clearer progress + error messaging for network preflight. Thoughts?

Devon: I like the micro-guides. Implementation note: preflight actually runs ~6 checks (DNS, egress, inbound ports, proxy, cert fetch, docker registry). We currently only show a single spinner per step. Can emit per-check lines so users see progress.

Sam: +1 on per-check lines. Copy tweak: replace vague verbs like "Checking" with friendlier phrases — e.g., "Validating network connectivity" or "Confirming inbound ports". Keeps it helpful for SREs and non-engineers. :mag:

Alex: Accessibility nit: contrast on the small status labels (12px, gray on white) is below 4.5:1. Also the modal that locks during the run traps keyboard focus — users who use screen readers lose context. Need aria-live updates and a focus management plan.

Marta: Good catches. Proposal: show a compact list under the step header with each check and its state (pending / success / failed). Make the step header show "1 of 6 checks passed" as a summary. We'll add an aria-live region for incremental updates.

Devon: Implementation sketch (PSUEDO):
```
{
  "step": "Network preflight",
  "checks": [
    {"name":"DNS resolution","status":"success"},
    {"name":"Outbound TLS","status":"pending"},
    {"name":"Inbound 443","status":"failed"}
  ]
}
```
We can stream these events to the frontend and animate per-line state changes. We'll respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Sam: UX decision: for failures, surface the highest-impact one first (port blocks > DNS) and show a prominent primary action: "Open troubleshooting" rather than burying multiple links. Keeps cognitive load low. :heavy_check_mark:

Marta: Agreed. Copy suggestion for error state: "Blocked — Open inbound port 443 to allow control-plane reachability. Open troubleshooting" (primary) and a secondary: "View full diagnostics".

Alex: For the tooltip / "Why we need this" copy, keep it short and link to docs. Make the tooltip keyboard-focusable and ensure role=\"tooltip\" pairs with aria-describedby on the label. Also confirm color contrast on the tooltip text. I'll run axe after the build.

ci-bot: deploy-preview: design preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/stepper-illustrated (expires in 24h)

Devon: I'll open the RFC + PR for the streaming status and the new stepper markup: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/123 — includes the aria-live plan and reduced-motion styles.

Marta: Awesome. Can someone volunteer for a quick accessibility pass after PR merges? @Alex?

Alex: I'll do keyboard + screen reader checks tomorrow morning. Will post results here. :thumbsup:

Sam: Leaving a small follow-up: consider an inline "retry" action per-failed-check (instead of full re-run) for transient egress issues. Saves time for busy infra teams.

Devon: Nice idea. I'll prototype a per-check retry button and flag idempotency concerns in the PR.

Marta: Perfect — thanks all. We'll reconvene after the preview feedback.
